sub_question: Filter job postings to those whose title is exactly 'Data Analyst', whose remote work indicator is true, and whose annual average salary is not null.
sub_sql:
SELECT
    job_title,
    job_work_from_home,
    salary_year_avg
FROM
    job_postings_fact
WHERE
    job_title = 'Data Analyst'               -- exact title match
    AND job_work_from_home = TRUE            -- remote work indicator
    AND salary_year_avg IS NOT NULL;         -- ensure salary is present
